name: Electricity Customer Onboarding
description: Onboards a new household customer of an electricity supplier: collects and verifies the documents, checks credit and identity and the metering point in parallel, decides eligibility, settles the electricity source, registers home generation for export, recommends a plan, has the contract signed, sets up billing and the direct debit, switches the supply, and welcomes the customer.

roles.name: Customer platform
roles.description: The supplier's customer platform (CRM): applications, customers and their messages.

roles.name: Document verifier
roles.description: Reads uploaded documents and checks that each one required is present, legible and consistent with the application.

roles.name: Credit and identity service
roles.description: Asks the credit bureau about the applicant.

roles.name: Metering-point registry
roles.description: The registry of metering points, through which suppliers switch.

roles.name: Credit officer
roles.description: Decides applications the eligibility rules refer to a person.

roles.name: Customer care agent
roles.description: Talks to customers by phone and resolves what the automated steps cannot.

roles.name: Plan advisor
roles.description: Recommends the plan that suits the household's consumption, with its estimated annual cost.

roles.name: Customer letters
roles.description: Writes letters and e-mails to customers.

roles.name: Grid export desk
roles.description: Registers home generation for export; the work is done by the Grid Export Registration workflow.

roles.name: Contract service
roles.description: Generates supply contracts and sends them for e-signature.

roles.name: Billing system
roles.description: Holds billing accounts, direct debit mandates and deposits.

contexts.name: customer_profile
contexts.description: The household as the agents that serve it need to know it: name, supply address, consumption, preferences, generation and devices. Credit results are not in it.

events.name: Application received
events.description: A household applies to become a customer on the web form.

events.name: Documents uploaded after reminder
events.description: Wait once more after the reminder.

events.name: Documents checked
events.description: The documents are verified: the credit check and the metering point lookup start in parallel.

events.name: Applicant verified
events.description: Tell other systems and the journey the applicant is verified.

events.name: Plan confirmed
events.description: Wait for the customer to confirm the plan in the portal.

events.name: Plan chosen
events.description: Tell other systems and the journey which plan and source the household chose.

events.name: Grid export settled
events.description: Tell other systems and the journey how the export registration ended.

events.name: Contract signed
events.description: Wait for the e-signature service to report the signed contract.

events.name: Switch completed
events.description: Wait for the registry to confirm the switch. If it has not by the deadline the wait fails the run (EVENT_TIMEOUT), and compensation cancels the deposit, the account and the mandate.

events.name: Customer activated
events.description: Tell other systems and the journey the customer is active.

events.name: Application abandoned
events.description: Tell other systems and the journey the application was abandoned.

events.name: Application declined
events.description: Tell other systems and the journey the application was declined.

activities.name: Register application
activities.description: Create the prospective customer and the customer profile the agents read.

tools.name: register_customer
tools.description: Create the prospective customer in the customer platform (CRM) and return its identifier.

activities.name: Request documents
activities.description: Ask the household for the documents the application needs, by e-mail.

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Send a message to the customer by e-mail, text message or post, through the notification service.

activities.name: Send document reminder
activities.description: Remind the household which documents are still missing and when the application will be closed without them.

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Send a message to the customer by e-mail, text message or post, through the notification service.

activities.name: Close as abandoned
activities.description: Close the application because the documents, or the signed contract, never came.

activities.name: Verify documents
activities.description: Check each required document: present, legible, of the right kind, and consistent with the application (name, address, account holder).
activities.procedure: For each document uploaded, call the document tool. Compare the name and address with the customer profile. Check that the identity document is in date and that the direct debit mandate is signed and names the applicant as account holder. List every required document with its status. Say how sure you are.

tools.name: extract_document
tools.description: Read an uploaded document: its type, whether it is legible, the fields printed on it and its text.

guardrails.name: Personal data in the verifier's notes

activities.name: Check credit and identity
activities.description: Ask the credit bureau for the credit band, outstanding energy debt and whether the identity matches.

tools.name: check_credit
tools.description: Ask the credit bureau for the applicant's credit band, outstanding energy debt and identity match.

activities.name: Look up metering point
activities.description: Read the metering point: meter type, smart meter or not, current supplier, connection capacity and region.

tools.name: lookup_metering_point
tools.description: Read a metering point from the metering-point registry: meter type, current supplier, connection capacity, region and grid operator.

activities.name: Credit referral
activities.description: A credit officer decides an application the eligibility rules referred, and any deposit.

activities.name: Write decline letter
activities.description: Write a polite letter declining the application, with the reason and what the household can do.

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Send a message to the customer by e-mail, text message or post, through the notification service.

postconditions.name: Says what the household can do

activities.name: Advise on electricity source
activities.description: A customer care agent agrees an electricity source with the customer when no option could be proposed.

activities.name: Recommend plan
activities.description: Recommend the plan that suits the household, with its estimated annual cost, putting the customer's preference first when it is eligible.
activities.procedure: Read the eligible plans and the customer profile. Estimate the annual cost of the customer's preferred plan and of the other eligible plans with the tariff tool. Recommend the preferred plan when it is eligible; otherwise the cheapest eligible plan for the profile. Give the reasons.

tools.name: estimate_annual_cost
tools.description: Estimate the annual cost of a plan for a consumption, a region and an electricity source, from the tariff catalogue.

activities.name: Confirm plan by phone
activities.description: A customer care agent calls the household, which has not confirmed a plan, and records the plan and source they choose.

activities.name: Register grid export
activities.description: Register the home's generation for export to the grid, by running the Grid Export Registration workflow.

activities.name: Agree another plan
activities.description: The export was not registered, so the prosumer plan cannot apply: a customer care agent agrees another plan with the customer.

activities.name: Generate contract
activities.description: Generate the supply contract, with the 14-day cooling-off period, and send it for e-signature.

tools.name: generate_contract
tools.description: Generate the supply contract for e-signature, with the plan, the source, the export tariff and the cooling-off period.

activities.name: Set up account and direct debit
activities.description: Open the billing account and register the direct debit mandate.

tools.name: create_billing_account
tools.description: Open the billing account and register the direct debit mandate.

activities.name: Collect deposit
activities.description: Collect the security deposit eligibility asked for.

tools.name: collect_deposit
tools.description: Collect a security deposit by direct debit.

activities.name: Request supplier switch
activities.description: Ask the registry to switch the supply from the current supplier.

tools.name: request_switch
tools.description: Ask the metering-point registry to switch the supply to this supplier.

activities.name: Write welcome pack
activities.description: Write the personalised welcome message: the plan, the electricity source, the supply start date and, for a home that exports, the export tariff.

guardrails.name: No bank or phone numbers in the welcome message

activities.name: Activate customer
activities.description: Mark the customer active from the supply start date and send the welcome pack.

tools.name: activate_customer
tools.description: Mark the customer active in the customer platform from the supply start date.

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Send a message to the customer by e-mail, text message or post, through the notification service.

activities.name: Cancel account and mandate
activities.description: Close the billing account and cancel the direct debit mandate of a switch that did not happen.

tools.name: cancel_billing_account
tools.description: Close a billing account and cancel its direct debit mandate.

activities.name: Refund deposit
activities.description: Refund the deposit of a switch that did not happen.

decision_nodes.name: Required documents
decision_nodes.description: The documents an application needs: three for every household, four more for a home with its own generation.

rules.description: Proof of ownership or authorisation of the installation

decision_nodes.name: Eligibility
decision_nodes.description: Whether the supplier takes the household on, from the credit band, outstanding energy debt and the identity check. The limits are examples each supplier sets.

rules.description: The identity does not match the person
Identity not confirmed: a person decides
Fair credit or a small debt: accepted with a deposit
Weak credit or a debt to look at: a person decides

decision_nodes.name: Electricity source
decision_nodes.description: Whether the source the customer chose is offered in their region. When it is not, an energy advisor model proposes the closest source that is.

rules.description: 100% renewable, backed by guarantees of origin: everywhere
Local community energy: where a community scheme supplies the region

decision_model.instructions: The customer chose an electricity source that is not offered in their region. Propose the available source closest to what they asked for: keep a renewable choice renewable, and a local choice as close to local generation as the region allows. Give the reason in one sentence the customer can read.

options.description: 100% renewable electricity backed by guarantees of origin, available in every region
A low-carbon mix of renewable and nuclear generation, available in every region
The standard supply mix, available in every region

decision_nodes.name: Plan eligibility
decision_nodes.description: The plans the household may choose: time-of-use needs a smart meter, the electric vehicle plan a declared charger, the prosumer plan home generation to register for export, the 24-month plan no deposit.

rules.description: Fixed price for 24 months, without a deposit
Time of use: needs a smart meter
Electric vehicle: needs a declared charger
Prosumer: needs home generation registered for export

edges.label: prosumer plan without an export registration
